description: Phase 3D. Exercises the psiphon-family activation lifecycle. Day 1 enables the experimental-families gate so psiphon routes are selectable. Day 3 drives a soak-only psiphon route activation; the rig asserts diagnostics carry `psiphon_active_route` matching the route and `psiphon_compiled_in` is true (release builds without the GPLv3 isolation tag MUST report compiled-in). Day 7 simulates a publisher-bundle rotation by clearing the active psiphon route; diagnostics MUST clear `psiphon_active_route` to empty within the same day. Day 14 exercises the locked invariant: psiphon is NOT opportunistic — auto-promotion MUST NOT promote a network whose only family is psiphon. The legacy subscription-url block layers so the distribution-failure invariants continue to assert.
